children: Germany plant breeder's fiscal yr revenue fell 3% and missed analyst expectations
Fiscal yr EBIT and EBITDA missed analyst estimates; EPS rose 13% yr/yr
Revenue decline driven by lower sugarbeet and corn acreage; one-time gain boosted EBITDA margin
KWS expects organic net sales growth of around 3% in fiscal 2026/2027
Company targets EBITDA margin of 19% to 20% for 2026/2027
KWS says outlook depends on recovery in agricultural markets
REDUCED ACREAGE - Co said lower sugarbeet and corn acreage drove revenue decline
ONE-TIME GAIN - Sale of license rights from North American corn business boosted EBITDA margin
NEGATIVE EXCHANGE RATE EFFECTS - Co said negative exchange rate effects reduced EBITDA
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the fishing & farming peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for KWS SAAT SE & Co KgaA is €80.50, about 2.4% above its September 22 closing price of €78.60
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
Sept 21 - German inflation to stay high, growth has slowed, Bundesbank says
